final: WITH c AS (SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Employee WHERE City IS NOT NULL GROUP BY City), s AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM c), r AS (SELECT c.City, c.n, c.n * 1.0 / s.total AS share FROM c JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avgn FROM r) SELECT r.City, r.n, r.share, r.n * 1.0 / a.avgn AS rel FROM r JOIN a ON a.avgn IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.City
